review_candidates.title: Technical Office Engineer
review_candidates.description: Company Description SEAPRO is a leading marine services company operating in Egypt and the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia, providing specialized solutions to the offshore oil & gas, marine infrastructure, commercial diving, underwater inspection, marine construction support, and offshore support sectors. With a commitment to international standards, advanced technology, and operational excellence, SEAPRO delivers integrated marine services through highly qualified professionals, modern equipment, and extensive regional experience, helping clients execute complex marine projects safely, efficiently, and cost-effectively. Role Description SEAPRO is seeking a Technical Office Engineer to join its Alexandria office on a full-time basis. The successful candidate will support the planning, coordination, documentation, and technical administration of commercial diving operations, underwater inspection activities, marine maintenance projects, and offshore support services. The role involves preparing technical and commercial proposals, reviewing client requirements and project specifications, coordinating with diving operations teams, supporting tender submissions, monitoring project progress, preparing technical reports, and ensuring compliance with company procedures and applicable industry standards. The Technical Office Engineer will serve as a key liaison between project management, diving operations, clients, and support departments to ensure the successful planning and execution of marine projects. Key Responsibilities Prepare technical proposals, method statements, project execution plans, and supporting documentation. Review tender documents, client specifications, and project requirements. Assist in preparing project cost estimates, budgets, and commercial offers. Coordinate with commercial diving teams and project managers regarding operational requirements and project execution plans. Prepare and maintain project documentation, technical reports, progress reports, and project records. Support project planning, scheduling, manpower allocation, and equipment utilization activities. Assist in evaluating project risks and operational requirements. Coordinate with procurement and logistics teams to ensure the availability of equipment, tools, and project resources. Monitor project progress and support management reporting activities. Ensure compliance with company procedures, client requirements, and applicable marine and diving industry standards. Support contract administration, variation orders, and project close-out documentation when required. Qualifications Bachelor's Degree in Engineering (Civil, Mechanical, Marine, Petroleum, or a related discipline). 2–5 years of experience in a Technical Office, Project Coordination, Project Engineering, or Engineering Support role. Previous experience in commercial diving, marine services, offshore operations, oil & gas, or marine construction projects is highly preferred. Strong technical writing, reporting, and documentation skills. Excellent proficiency in Microsoft Office applications, particularly Excel, Word, and PowerPoint. Ability to prepare technical and commercial proposals. Strong analytical, organizational, and problem-solving skills. Effective communication and coordination abilities. Ability to work in a dynamic project-driven environment. Fluent English communication skills, both written and verbal. Preferred Qualifications Experience in offshore oil & gas projects. Knowledge of project planning, cost control, and project reporting practices. Understanding of commercial diving operations, underwater inspection, and marine maintenance activities.

It has been identified as a position necessary to carry out and support the mission of the US Cyber Command. It is in the Supervision/Management Work Category at the Expert Work Level within the CES Occupational Structure. It is located in the DISA DODNET PROGRAM CONTROLS DIVISION. Duties Help Manages all administrative and business management services essential to the operation of the directorate’s information management mission. Responsible for management and program analysis, space management, manpower, and personnel management. Responsible for Service Strategy, Service Design, Service Transition, Service Operations, and Continual Service Improvement as it relates to optimizing the efficiency of the Directorate and its use of human capital Participates in reviews to determine program status and works directly with engineering, testing, installation, financial working groups, to ensure requirements for workforce milestones are in compliance with statutes, DoD policy and instructions. Responsible for a $1M.5 training and $3M awards budget. Requirements Help Conditions of employment Must be a U.S. Citizen. Males born after 12-31-59 must be registered or exempt from Selective Service. This national security position, which may require access to classified information, requires a favorable suitability review and security clearance as a condition of employment. Failure to maintain security eligibility may result in termination. In accordance with the DoD 8140 policy series, the position is subject to completing Foundational Qualifications in 9 months and completing Residential Qualification requirements overall in 12 months. This is a drug testing position. Must complete an OGE Form 450, Confidential Financial Disclosure Report within 30 days of appointment. Must have/obtain Program Management Advanced Certification (or be eligible for certification within 48 months of appointment) in the DAWIA Program Management Functional Area. Qualifications In order to qualify for this position, you must meet the requirements described below. Qualifying Experience To qualify at the GG-15, your resume must describe at least one year of experience that demonstrates the competencies necessary for immediate success in the position. Experience refers to any paid or unpaid experience, including volunteer work and Military service, that would be considered equivalent to work normally performed at the next lower grade level in the federal service. For this position, qualifying experience is defined as: Experience managing administrative and business management services to support organizational missions, manpower planning, personnel management, or human capital management. Candidates must describe how they meet the qualifying experience and/or selective placement factor(s) within the body of their resume. All qualifications must be met within 30 days after the closing date of this announcement. Education There is no substitution of education for the qualifying experienceat the GG-15 grade level. This position is subject to completion of 1 year probationary period for assignment to a supervisory position. Accepting this position, you may be required to serve a 1-year probationary during which we will evaluate your fitness and whether your continued employment advances the public interest. This position is covered under DoD Manual 8140 which will be subject to future Cyber Workforce requirements as defined by the Manual. Acquisition workforce employees must achieve 80 hours of Continuous Learning Points (CLPs) every two years, in accordance with DoDI 5000.66. Obtaining certification within the allotted grace period and maintaining CLPs before and after achieving certification are conditions of employment. If certification is not received within 48 months of appointment as defined by DAWIA, and training not completed within the established guidelines, the incumbent might be removed from this position. Additional information may be found at: https://www.dau.edu/back-to-basics. PPP Application Based Preference Eligibles (Military Reserve and National Guard technicians, Military Reserve and National Guard technicians receiving disability retirement, and Retained Grade employees) will receive priority consideration at the full performance level only. Because this position is in the Cyber Excepted Service, Veterans' Preference will be applied to preference eligible candidates, as defined by Section 2108 of the Title 5 U.S.C. in accordance with the procedures provided in DoD Instruction 1400.25, Volume 3005, "CES Employment and Placement." If you are a veteran claiming veteran's preference, as defined by Section 2108 of Title 5 U.S.C., you must submit documents verifying your eligibility with your application package. If you are unable to apply on-line, you may contact 317-212-0454 for assistance. review_candidates.title: Staff Data Center Mechanical Engineer
review_candidates.description: Job Req ID: 27962 About Supermicro Supermicro® is a Top Tier provider of advanced server, storage, and networking solutions for Data Center, Cloud Computing, Enterprise IT, Hadoop/ Big Data, Hyperscale, HPC and IoT/Embedded customers worldwide. We are the #5 fastest growing company among the Silicon Valley Top 50 technology firms. Our unprecedented global expansion has provided us with the opportunity to offer a large number of new positions to the technology community. We seek talented, passionate, and committed engineers, technologists, and business leaders to join us. Job Summary Supermicro seeks an experienced Staff Data Center Mechanical Engineer to design mechanical systems for advanced AI and hyperscale data centers. This role standardizes mechanical frameworks, including OPR and BOD documents, ensuring facilities meet high standards for performance, reliability, and energy efficiency. The ideal candidate has strong data center mechanical engineering experience, understands wet and dry systems, and can learn liquid-cooling technologies. They will work with consultants, construction teams, and global partners to deliver cost-effective, code-compliant, scalable data centers. Essential Duties And Responsibilities Essential Duties and Responsibilities: Lead the mechanical design scope for new and retrofit data centers, covering air- and liquid-cooling systems, and design the systems to meet redundancy and efficiency targets. Develop and maintain mechanical design standards, OPRs, and BODs for all Supermicro data center programs. Perform load calculations, system sizing, and equipment selection for pumps, chillers, cooling towers, dry coolers, and heat exchangers. Collaborate with electrical, controls, and architectural teams to optimize overall facility layout, energy use, and serviceability. Provide engineering oversight for plumbing and fire-protection system design, ensuring full code compliance and integration with mechanical infrastructure. Review consultant and contractor drawings, specifications, and submittals to verify accuracy and adherence to Supermicro standards. Be familiar with OCP standards such as facility design and liquid-cooling requirements, and with ASHRAE guidelines for thermal management and environmental control. Support commissioning activities, including factory acceptance testing (FAT), site inspections, and integrated systems testing (IST). Identify and evaluate new cooling technologies such as rear-door heat exchangers, immersion cooling, and liquid-to-liquid heat-transfer systems. Lead energy-efficiency initiatives aimed at improving PUE and WUE across all projects. Manage mechanical system risk assessments and provide mitigation strategies during design and construction phases. Interface with utilities and permitting authorities to ensure smooth project execution and compliance. Document lessons learned and contribute to continuous improvement of mechanical design templates and workflows. Additional Responsibilities Mentor engineers and teams as mechanical systems expert. Train internal staff and join design and commissioning events. Assess vendors, review equipment, and test standard components. Keep up with ASHRAE TC 9.9, sustainability, and new mechanical tech for dense computing. Qualifications Required Qualifications: Bachelor’s in Mechanical Engineering or related field At least 10 years’ experience designing mission-critical or hyperscale data centers PE license required Expertise in HVAC: chilled-water, condenser-water, air-handling systems Knowledge of wet/dry mechanical systems, plumbing, fire protection Able to lead mechanical design from concept to commissioning Experience managing multidisciplinary teams and external consultants Familiar with U.S. and international codes (ASHRAE, NFPA, ISO, local AHJ) Strong analytical and communication skills; detail-oriented Willing to travel up to 50% domestically/internationally Preferred Qualifications Master’s in Mechanical Engineering Data center cooling systems experience, including high-density and modular integration Skilled in CFD analysis and BIM/Revit for airflow, thermal, and spatial planning Knowledgeable in sustainable design: economizers, heat-recovery, free-cooling Managed mechanical work for prefabricated or modular data centers Proven vendor collaboration, system optimization, and infrastructure delivery Salary Range $200,000 - $245,000 The salary offered will depend on several factors, including your location, level, education, training, specific skills, years of experience, and comparison to other employees already in this role. In addition to a comprehensive benefits package, candidates may be eligible for other forms of compensation, such as participation in bonus and equity award programs. EEO Statement Supermicro is an Equal Opportunity Employer and embraces diversity in our employee population. It is the policy of Supermicro to provide equal opportunity to all qualified applicants and employees without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, protected veteran status or special disabled veteran, marital status, pregnancy, genetic information, or any other legally protected status.

review_candidates.title: Sr. Sales Specialist, Govt. HighQ & Partnership Sales
review_candidates.description: Sr. Sales Specialist Thomson Reuters is seeking a highly experienced and strategic Senior Sales Specialist to drive growth of HighQ and CoCounsel — two of Thomson Reuters' most transformative and innovative platforms — along with our expanding Partnerships and Alliances portfolio within the Government segment. This is a senior-level, quota-carrying individual contributor role operating at the intersection of complex technology sales, government procurement, enterprise account strategy, and a rapidly growing ecosystem of partner solutions. At Thomson Reuters, we win together. This role thrives in a team selling environment where collaboration, trust, and shared accountability are the foundation of success. The ideal candidate is not only a skilled sales professional, but a natural collaborator who knows how to bring out the best in those around them — aligning internal teams, partners, and stakeholders toward a common goal. They bring deep public sector expertise, a consultative sales approach, and the ability to orchestrate cross-functional resources to deliver transformative solutions to state and federal government clients. Location: remote based position, must be based in the US. About The Role In this opportunity as a Sr. Sales Specialist, you will: HighQ Sales Serve as the subject matter expert and primary sales driver for HighQ within the Government segment, articulating its value as a platform that eliminates barriers to service delivery, minimizes administrative burden, and reduces overhead costs by streamlining document sharing, task allocation, and data transparency — while seamlessly integrating to lessen the risk of missing vital information. Position and sell HighQ's full capabilities to government legal departments, including matter intake, contract lifecycle and asset management, and end-to-end transaction and litigation management. Demonstrate the value of HighQ's secure platform that integrates advanced AI capabilities and agentic solutions directly into legal workflows, delivering exceptional experiences with 24/7 access to legal matters, real-time document collaboration, and embedded AI for instant insights. CoCounsel Sales Serve as a sales driver and subject matter expert for CoCounsel — Thomson Reuters' generative AI-powered legal assistant — within the Government segment. Navigate government-specific AI adoption concerns, including data privacy, security, acceptable use policies, and responsible AI governance, with confidence and expertise — working cross-functionally with legal, compliance, and security teams to address agency requirements. Partner closely with Westlaw and Practical Law specialists to position CoCounsel as the AI layer that amplifies the value of the broader TR content ecosystem within government accounts. Partnerships & Alliances Sales Drive revenue growth through the sale of current and future partnership products within the Government segment, executing full-cycle sales motions including prospecting, discovery, demos, and closing. Maintain deep and current product knowledge of Thomson Reuters' partnership offerings and other emerging partner solutions — and confidently position them as complementary capabilities that extend the value of the core TR platform for government legal teams. Prospect and qualify government accounts for partnership products using defined criteria, identifying opportunities where partner solutions address specific agency workflows, litigation needs, complex case management requirements, or high-volume document environments. Partner with Government territory owners and account executives to identify and support partnership opportunities within strategic accounts, ensuring a coordinated and seamless experience for the client. Collaborate with partner teams for technical support, co-selling motions, and onboarding coordination — representing Thomson Reuters with professionalism and expertise throughout the partner engagement lifecycle. Leverage Salesforce tagging and enablement tools to track, manage, and report on partnership opportunities, pipeline activity, and deal progression with accuracy and discipline. Lead co-selling motions with partner organizations and transition to independent selling as enablement matures, demonstrating increasing fluency and confidence across the full partnerships portfolio. Complete enablement certifications and maintain up-to-date product fluency across all current and future partnership offerings, serving as a credible and knowledgeable resource for both internal teammates and government clients. Strategic & Cross-Functional Sales Leadership Lead complex, multi-stakeholder sales engagements across Thomson Reuters' full product portfolio in strategic government accounts, coordinating across product lines including CoCounsel Legal, HighQ, and partner solutions. Serve as the sales lead for cross-functional sales teams, aligning resources across product specialists, solution engineers, customer success, legal, and executive leadership to pursue and close large, strategic opportunities — and doing so in a way that is inclusive, communicative, and respectful of each team member's expertise. Engage at the executive and agency leadership level to position Thomson Reuters as a strategic technology partner — not just a vendor — across the full spectrum of government legal and operational needs. Actively contribute to a culture of shared success by openly communicating pipeline activity, sharing competitive intelligence, and supporting teammates across the broader Government sales organization. Understand that individual success in this role is directly tied to the success of the team — and approach every opportunity with that mindset. State & Federal Government Focus Navigate complex government procurement processes, including RFPs, sole-source justifications, cooperative purchasing vehicles, and GSA/contract schedules — partnering closely with proposal, legal, and pricing teams to put forward the strongest possible response. Build and maintain deep relationships with key stakeholders across state attorneys general offices, federal agencies, legislative bodies, courts, and public legal departments. Stay current on government regulatory trends, legal technology mandates, AI governance policies, and agency modernization initiatives to proactively align TR solutions with evolving needs. Collaborate with government affairs, channel, and partner teams to maximize reach and influence across both state and federal ecosystems. About You You're a fit for the role of Sr. Sales Specialist if you are/have: 7+ years of experience in sales within the public sector (state and/or federal government), with a demonstrated track record of closing complex, high-value technology deals. A true team player with a collaborative mindset and a proven ability to work effectively across matrixed organizations — including with account executives, product specialists, solution engineers, partner teams, marketing, and executive sponsors. Demonstrated success operating in a team selling model, where credit is shared, communication is constant, and the collective outcome matters more than individual recognition. Deep understanding of government procurement cycles, budget processes, and the unique compliance and security requirements of public sector agencies. Proven ability to lead cross-functional sales efforts and manage multi-threaded enterprise opportunities from prospecting through close. Experience selling SaaS platforms, legal technology, AI-powered solutions, or information services strongly preferred. Familiarity with AI adoption trends in the public sector, including responsible AI frameworks, data governance, and government security standards such as FedRAMP. Strong understanding of AI-driven legal solutions, document intelligence, and high-volume document environments as they apply to government legal workflows including litigation and complex case management. Familiarity with file sharing, collaboration, project management, virtual data rooms, enterprise social networking, and knowledge sharing solutions is a plus. Experience with Salesforce, virtual demos, and remote selling required. Exceptional executive presence and communication skills, with the ability to present complex solutions clearly to both technical and non-technical government stakeholders. Strong business acumen with the ability to build compelling ROI and value-based business cases. Known internally and externally as someone who is easy to work with, dependable, and who elevates the performance of everyone around them. Ability to travel as required to support strategic accounts across state and federal territories. What’s in it For You? Flexibility & Work-Life Balance: Flex My Way is a set of supportive workplace policies designed to help manage personal and professional responsibilities, whether caring for family, giving back to the community, or finding time to refresh and reset. This builds upon our flexible work arrangements, including work from anywhere for up to 8 weeks per year, empowering employees to achieve a better work-life balance. Career Development and Growth: By fostering a culture of continuous learning and skill development, we prepare our talent to tackle tomorrow’s challenges and deliver real-world solutions. Our Grow My Way programming and skills-first approach ensures you have the tools and knowledge to grow, lead, and thrive in an AI-enabled future. Industry Competitive Benefits: We offer comprehensive benefit plans to include flexible vacation, two company-wide Mental Health Days off, access to the Headspace app, retirement savings, tuition reimbursement, employee incentive programs, and resources for mental, physical, and financial wellbeing. Culture: Globally recognized, award-winning reputation for inclusion and belonging, flexibility, work-life balance, and more. We live by our values: Obsess over our Customers, Compete to Win, Challenge (Y)our Thinking, Act Fast / Learn Fast, and Stronger Together. Social Impact: Make an impact in your community with our Social Impact Institute. We offer employees two paid volunteer days off annually and opportunities to get involved with pro-bono consulting projects and Environmental, Social, and Governance (ESG) initiatives. Making a Real-World Impact: We are one of the few companies globally that helps its customers pursue justice, truth, and transparency. Together, with the professionals and institutions we serve, we help uphold the rule of law, turn the wheels of commerce, catch bad actors, report the facts, and provide trusted, unbiased information to people all over the world. In the United States, Thomson Reuters offers a comprehensive benefits package to our employees. Our benefit package includes market competitive health, dental, vision, disability, and life insurance programs, as well as a competitive 401k plan with company match. In addition, Thomson Reuters offers market leading work life benefits with competitive vacation, sick and safe paid time off, paid holidays (including two company mental health days off), parental leave, sabbatical leave. These benefits meet or exceeds the requirements of paid time off in accordance with any applicable state or municipal laws. Finally, Thomson Reuters offers the following additional benefits: optional hospital, accident and sickness insurance paid 100% by the employee; optional life and AD&D insurance paid 100% by the employee; Flexible Spending and Health Savings Accounts; fitness reimbursement; access to Employee Assistance Program; Group Legal Identity Theft Protection benefit paid 100% by employee; access to 529 Plan; commuter benefits; Adoption & Surrogacy Assistance; Tuition Reimbursement; and access to Employee Stock Purchase Plan.
